recap:
## Decisions
- Remote will control only the TV: no DVD, TiVo or stereo functions [00:16:03]
- Remote will carry the company colour and logo [00:17:25]
- Target group is all ages, including kids [00:19:03]
- Design for the least technically literate user [00:19:23]
- Core buttons are channel, power, volume and mute [00:20:13]
- Keep the number of buttons low [00:20:22]
- Keep the 0–9 number buttons [00:24:03]
- Drop play, fast-forward and rewind buttons [00:25:37]
- Add one menu button for audio, screen and other settings, with the channel and volume buttons used to navigate it [00:27:31]
- Include an extra light that shows the remote is working [00:14:52]
- The remote should be easy to find if lost [00:20:52]

## Action items
- ID: Work on the components concept [00:28:48]
- UI: Work on the user interface concept [00:28:52]
- ME: Do trend watching [00:28:56]
- PM: Type up the minutes for this meeting [00:28:42]
- PM, ID, UI, ME: Reply to the questionnaire and summary email [00:28:25]

## Unresolved
- Power source: rechargeable base/charger or batteries only [00:21:59]
- How to make the remote findable, such as a base with a locator button that makes it beep [00:21:23]
- Whether to include speech recognition, and whether the receiver goes in the remote, the base or the TV [00:23:01]
- How to apply the yellow colour and logo: a strip, yellow key lights, or a fully yellow remote, which ME thinks would be too garish [00:25:08]
- Button size and shape: larger buttons, a large on-off button, round "bubble" buttons [00:15:38]
- Budget fit, deferred to a later discussion of project financing [00:24:40]
